newsitem.title: USA: Coda Music launches private stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Coda Music launches private stock offering.

text.p: Coda Music Technology Inc said Friday it will make a private offering of its stock.

Coda is offering at least 1,153,846 and maximum of 1,730,769 shares for $1.30 a share. In addition, purchasers will receive for each two shares purchased a warrant to purchase one additional share at $2.00 a share subject to certain adjustments.
Venture capital funds have indicated their intention to purchase at least 865,385 of the shares, Coda said.
Proceeds of the offering will be used for sales and marketing, development of Coda's Vivace product and repertoire and working capital, the company said.
The offering is scheduled to close May 29 subject to extension by the company of up to 60 days.
